title: Notes on slow reading
transcriptText:
Finished chapter four with a warm cup of coffee beside the window. Physical paper remembers where your attention lingered—a dog-eared corner, a yellow highlight, a margin note in pencil.
Digital journals usually flatten everything into uniform rows. Giving quotes real breathing room changes how you remember your own life.
